figures.caption: Figure 1. The proposed classification system starts with motor real or imagery tasks. A consumer-graded and a research EEG device simultaneously acquire brain activity. The system preprocesses EEG signals to enter the machine learning algorithms. The expected result is compared to the trial performed by the subject, and the classification identifies the task, motor real or imagery.
